## Description

One medicine list per country that every clinic of that country sees: the formulary rows with no tenant (ADR-015). The Medvya team manages it in the platform console; clinics keep adding their own medicines and brands, and doctors keep free text. The console reaches only those rows, through a narrow reviewed database login (medvya_formulary: read, add and update of the shared rows of prescribing.FormularyItems; row-level security keeps every clinic's own rows out even if it sets a tenant), the same way the organisation review login was added (ADR-014 note). A new class "Not verified" marks a shared row whose Schedule or controlled class nobody has confirmed: it never prints as an ordinary medicine (the paper says the class is not verified) and the composer says so. A row can carry the register's code and release, so a later import (MDV-P5-066) is idempotent per release.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an Owner or Operations member, when they search the list for India or the UAE, then they see each medicine's source, class, register code and whether it is active; Support, Finance and Reviewer read only and every write is refused with 403 (server-side).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a console member adds a Medvya-wide medicine, when it breaks the clinic add's rules (FormularyRules: form, class of the country, ATC, national code, lengths) or is already listed, then it is refused with the same codes.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a console write (add, correct, set class, deactivate), when it has no reason, then it is refused before anything changes; with a reason it is appended to the platform audit log.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a medicine whose class an advisor has reviewed, when Operations sets its class with a reason, then clinics see the new class and its print requirements.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given a medicine is deactivated, when a doctor searches, then it is not offered and it is never deleted.
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the console's formulary login, when it reads or writes, then it sees and changes only rows with no tenant, even with a tenant setting, and it has no right on any other table.
- [ ] **AC7.** Given a medicine whose class is Not verified, when a doctor finds it or prints a prescription with it, then the composer shows "Class not verified" and the paper carries a line that the class is not verified.

## Test notes

- Integration on real PostgreSQL: roles, reason, audit entry, narrow login (mutation-checked), Not verified print requirement; vitest for the page's domain; browser check in English and Arabic with axe.

## Notes / open questions

- Not here: the CDCI import (MDV-P5-066), reactivating a medicine, the console design (ask the designer), Schedule mapping from CDSCO (advisor).
- Search speed: a trigram index cannot serve this search, because row-level security lets PostgreSQL use an index only for leakproof operators (ILIKE and pg_trgm are not; measured 15 Nov 2026 on 100,000 rows: about 240 ms, sequential). Index-backed search is an acceptance criterion of MDV-P5-066.
